newsitem.title: USA: Aware licenses technology to U.S. Robotics.
newsitem.headline: Aware licenses technology to U.S. Robotics.

text.p: Aware Inc said Friday it had licensed its DMT technology to U.S. Robotics Corp for use in transmission products that it was developing.

The company said Robotics would use its DMT in Digital Subscriber Line (DSL) products, which transmit data, voice and video over traditional copper telephone wires at a much faster rate than modems used by consumers.
"U.S. Robotics has the clout in the modem business to bring DSL to millions of consumers and businesses," it said without disclosing the terms of the deal.
Aware makes hardware and software for broadband communications and high-speed access to the Internet.
U.S. Robotics is one of the world's leading suppliers of products and systems like modems that provide access to information.
